drums.description: Boom bap hip hop beat, A dry, punchy kick drum and a crisp, high-frequency snare drum establish a steady 4/4 rhythm at 90 BPM, A syncopated, percussive woodblock or rimshot sound accents the off-beats, A low-pass filtered electric bass guitar plays a repetitive two-bar groove focusing on the root and fifth, A sampled, staccato piano chord stabs on the second and fourth beats of every measure, processed with a slight vinyl crackle and bit-crushing effect, A subtle, high-pitched sine wave synth whistle enters periodically, performing a minimalist two-note melody with heavy portamento, The track is in the key of C minor, The mix is centered with a narrow stereo field, emphasizing a mono-compatible low end Publish
